messages.text: I support NG/MJ. JN's proposed NJ exchange is substantive, but it would make Wayfarer permanently available for council carriage and displace the commercial freedom we have just shown can sustain communities. I will not purchase army agreement with that obligation. MJ gives the army a required voice in Security; it does not let the Guild order combat alone. I respect your opposition, but I prefer this package to surrendering navigation discretion or accepting MA's withdrawal of civilian protection.

reason: GS and I independently favour the same package, though our signatures still require an explicit ballot. Guild and Ascendant can meet the published threshold if both actually sign. That permits a settlement despite military refusal; it does not authorise pretending the army consented or that its institutional objection is trivial.
